## Columns

One row per plate appearance. 47 columns. A row is identified by `game_pk` + `at_bat_number`.

```{=html}
<div class="store-dict"><table class="table">
<thead><tr>
<th>Column</th>
<th>Type</th>
<th>What it holds</th>
</tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td>game_pk</td><td>string</td><td>MLB&#x27;s id for the game, the same id MLB.com and Baseball Savant use.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_date</td><td>date</td><td>Official date of the game; a suspended game keeps the date it started.</td></tr>
<tr><td>season</td><td>int</td><td>Season the game belongs to, as a four-digit year.</td></tr>
<tr><td>season_type</td><td>string</td><td>regular for the regular season, postseason for every playoff round.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_type</td><td>string</td><td>MLB game type code: R regular season, F wild card round, D division series, L league championship series, W World Series.</td></tr>
<tr><td>at_bat_number</td><td>int</td><td>Sequence number of the plate appearance within the game, starting at 1; a number is occasionally skipped where the source has no pitch for a turn at bat.</td></tr>
<tr><td>inning</td><td>int</td><td>Inning number, starting at 1.</td></tr>
<tr><td>half</td><td>string</td><td>top when the away team bats, bottom when the home team bats.</td></tr>
<tr><td>batting_team_id</td><td>string</td><td>MLB id of the team at bat.</td></tr>
<tr><td>batting_team</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the team at bat.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fielding_team_id</td><td>string</td><td>MLB id of the team in the field.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fielding_team</td><td>string</td><td>Abbreviation of the team in the field.</td></tr>
<tr><td>batter_id</td><td>string</td><td>MLB (MLBAM) id of the batter charged with the plate appearance.</td></tr>
<tr><td>batter_name</td><td>string</td><td>Batter&#x27;s full name.</td></tr>
<tr><td>bats</td><td>string</td><td>Side of the plate the batter hit from: L or R.</td></tr>
<tr><td>pitcher_id</td><td>string</td><td>MLB (MLBAM) id of the pitcher charged with the plate appearance: whoever threw the final pitch, except a walk finished by a reliever who entered behind in the count, which goes to the pitcher he replaced.</td></tr>
<tr><td>pitcher_name</td><td>string</td><td>Pitcher&#x27;s full name.</td></tr>
<tr><td>throws</td><td>string</td><td>Hand the pitcher throws with: L or R.</td></tr>
<tr><td>times_faced</td><td>int</td><td>Which meeting of this batter and this pitcher in the game it is: 1 the first time, 2 the second.</td></tr>
<tr><td>outs</td><td>int</td><td>Outs when the plate appearance began.</td></tr>
<tr><td>on_1b</td><td>bool</td><td>True when a runner was on first base when the plate appearance began.</td></tr>
<tr><td>on_2b</td><td>bool</td><td>True when a runner was on second base when the plate appearance began.</td></tr>
<tr><td>on_3b</td><td>bool</td><td>True when a runner was on third base when the plate appearance began.</td></tr>
<tr><td>bat_score</td><td>int</td><td>Batting team&#x27;s runs when the plate appearance began.</td></tr>
<tr><td>fld_score</td><td>int</td><td>Fielding team&#x27;s runs when the plate appearance began.</td></tr>
<tr><td>pitches</td><td>int</td><td>Pitches thrown in the plate appearance; automatic balls and strikes are not pitches.</td></tr>
<tr><td>swings</td><td>int</td><td>Pitches the batter swung at, bunt attempts included.</td></tr>
<tr><td>final_pitch_type</td><td>string</td><td>Statcast pitch type code of the last pitch (FF four-seam fastball, SI sinker, SL slider, CH changeup and so on); blank when it was not classified.</td></tr>
<tr><td>event</td><td>string</td><td>Statcast outcome of the plate appearance (single, strikeout, walk, field_out, home_run and so on); truncated_pa or blank when the turn at bat did not finish.</td></tr>
<tr><td>completed_pa</td><td>bool</td><td>True for an official plate appearance; false when the inning ended on the bases before the batter&#x27;s turn finished.</td></tr>
<tr><td>at_bat</td><td>bool</td><td>True when the plate appearance counts as an official at-bat.</td></tr>
<tr><td>hit</td><td>bool</td><td>True when the batter got a hit.</td></tr>
<tr><td>total_bases</td><td>int</td><td>Bases the batter earned on a hit: 1, 2, 3 or 4, and 0 otherwise.</td></tr>
<tr><td>runs_scored</td><td>int</td><td>Runs that scored on the final play of the plate appearance.</td></tr>
<tr><td>bat_score_after</td><td>int</td><td>Batting team&#x27;s runs when the next plate appearance began or the half inning ended; it exceeds bat_score plus runs_scored when a run came in away from the final play, on a wild pitch, balk or steal.</td></tr>
<tr><td>in_play</td><td>bool</td><td>True when the plate appearance ended with the ball put in play.</td></tr>
<tr><td>bb_type</td><td>string</td><td>Batted ball type for a ball in play: ground_ball, line_drive, fly_ball or popup.</td></tr>
<tr><td>launch_speed</td><td>float</td><td>Exit velocity of the ball in play in miles per hour, where Statcast tracked it.</td></tr>
<tr><td>launch_angle</td><td>float</td><td>Vertical launch angle of the ball in play in degrees, where Statcast tracked it.</td></tr>
<tr><td>hit_distance</td><td>float</td><td>Statcast&#x27;s projected distance of the ball in play in feet.</td></tr>
<tr><td>hit_x</td><td>float</td><td>Horizontal position where the ball in play was fielded on Statcast&#x27;s field diagram; home plate is near 125 and larger values are toward right field.</td></tr>
<tr><td>hit_y</td><td>float</td><td>Vertical position where the ball in play was fielded on Statcast&#x27;s field diagram; home plate is near 199 and smaller values are deeper.</td></tr>
<tr><td>launch_speed_angle</td><td>int</td><td>Statcast contact class for the ball in play: 1 weak, 2 topped, 3 under, 4 flare or burner, 5 solid contact, 6 barrel.</td></tr>
<tr><td>barrel</td><td>bool</td><td>True when Statcast classes the ball in play as a barrel.</td></tr>
<tr><td>estimated_woba</td><td>float</td><td>Statcast&#x27;s expected wOBA for the ball in play, from its exit velocity and launch angle.</td></tr>
<tr><td>infield_alignment</td><td>string</td><td>Statcast&#x27;s reading of the infield positioning on the final pitch: Standard, Infield shade, Infield shift (through 2022) or Strategic.</td></tr>
<tr><td>outfield_alignment</td><td>string</td><td>Statcast&#x27;s reading of the outfield positioning on the final pitch: Standard, Strategic or 4th outfielder (through 2022).</td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>
```

## Source and method

Built from Baseball Savant Statcast pitch data, one row per plate appearance, with player names from the MLB Stats API. Batted-ball measurements are filled only for balls put in play that Statcast tracked. Individual pitches, baserunning events and fielder credits are not included.

The same file layout, IDs and column names are used for every season, so seasons stack without cleanup. See [how the store works](help.qmd) for formats, delivery and the license.

## More MLB data

[Player Game Logs](mlb-player-logs.qmd) · [Team Game Logs](mlb-team-logs.qmd) · [Games and Results](mlb-schedule.qmd) · [All MLB data](mlb.qmd)

::: {.faq-item}
### How do the MLB files join to each other?

On the ID columns. Game, team and player IDs are the same strings in every MLB file and every season, so a join on `game_id` (plus `team` or `player_id` where the grain needs it) lines them up.
:::

::: {.faq-item}
### Which games are included?

Every regular-season and postseason game, built from the official game feeds and Statcast. Regular season and postseason sit in the same file, told apart by `season_type`. Preseason and All-Star games are left out.
:::
